culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Ichiro Tamaki. His intentions wasn't to kill his father but only destroy the old bookstore that Yujiro wanted not closed. The father and son reconciled at the end and Yujiro didn't press charges on his son because he knew what he felt for doing that. After three months, they open a book café that is visited by the Detective Boys and Conan.

summary.en:
Location: Tamaki's used bookstore

Victim: Yujiro Tamaki

Age: 65 years old
